decisions.text: arranged: rows by province or territory: no comparison within a panel is stated (facts.compare): one series per panel, the most panels and the least clutter (13-15 DP-1); 12 panels are stacked in rows (more than 6 across would be too narrow); runner-up for review: series in each panel by province or territory (D-38 (i))
one colour for every mark: every variable is on the rows or columns (G7.50)
type line: a regular series whose pattern of change is the point (06 DP6-1, G1.51)
a scale per panel: the message compares the shapes of series of very different sizes (facts.compare_shapes): each panel its own scale, which shows each shape but loses the comparison of sizes (G7.48)

source.shows: the same stack with a scale per panel, because the message is the shape of each series, not its size (facts.compare_shapes; R6-37, G7.48): each panel its own scale, which need not start at zero, the shapes of the small territories visible where the shared scale crushes them; the sizes can no longer be compared across panels
